basic.question: What does my chart say about my health?
basic.framework: Check 6th house, Sun/Moon placement, and dasha periods
basic.answer_template: Your 6th house {condition} indicates health tendencies. Sun {status} shows vitality, Moon {status} emotional health, Mars {status} physical energy.
basic.strength_check: 6th house strength indicates resistance to illness; benefics in dusthan give cautionary indications

basic.question: When will I recover from illness?
basic.framework: Check dasha of lagna lord, aspect of Jupiter on 6th house
basic.answer_template: Current {dasha} dasha {recovery_status}. Jupiter aspect on 6th house {jupiter_status}. Favorable period: {timing}.
basic.strength_check: Jupiter strongest healer; lagna lord dasha indicates recovery period

intermediate.question: Will I have chronic health issues?
intermediate.framework: Check 6th house strength, Saturn position, and dasha periods
intermediate.strength_check: Strong 6th = minimal chronic issues; Weak 6th + Saturn = long-term concerns

intermediate.question: What remedies help my health?
intermediate.framework: Check Sun/Moon strength, lord of 6th house, and appropriate upays
intermediate.answer_template: Sun remedy: {sun_remedy}. Moon remedy: {moon_remedy}. 6th lord remedy: {sixth_remedy}. Direction: {direction}.
intermediate.strength_check: Benefic remedies for strong planets; malefic remedies for weak planets
